question: are the labels readable from changeset metadata alone?

criterion.metric: ROC-AUC on a class-balanced user-disjoint test fold
criterion.why_not_f1: On a balanced set, predicting everything positive scores F1 = 0.667. An F1 threshold of 0.70 therefore sits barely above trivial and fails honest weak models. Rank quality is what separates a leak from a prior.

interpretation: Editor string carries most of it. The strongest positive coefficient is the beginner-facing editor, which matches the top OSMCha harmful reason ('New mapper') and is a real property of who vandalises, not a label leak. Ovid uses the same feature. It is reported as a baseline, not excluded.
